title: Constrained Local Refinement with Bounded Step Size
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness updates to ±15 nm from the previous best candidate (opt_aperiodic_hfosio2_24l__gradien__ae5ad96294fa) will resolve coarse optimization jumps while preserving the dual-band spectral balance achieved in round 1.
design_principle: Local refinement with bounded step size prevents large thickness deviations that disrupt established interference conditions. A gentle harmonic penalty toward quarter-wave optical thickness at 1150 nm guides the SWIR transmission band without constraining UV reflection design freedom.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating stack: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate. Total finite layers: 24 (12 HfO2 + 12 SiO2 pairs).
design_variables: Layer thicknesses with bounds set to previous_best_thickness ± 15 nm per layer
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 800-1500 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 200-400 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Materials limited to HfO2 and SiO2
theory_basis: Local optimization with bounded step size prevents disruption of established spectral features
expected_advantages: Reduces risk of large thickness jumps disrupting interference conditions
Quarter-wave bias at 1150 nm improves SWIR transmission phase alignment
known_risks: Bounded search may miss global optimum if previous candidate is in local minimum
Quarter-wave penalty may constrain UV reflection optimization
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize thicknesses from previous best candidate: [94.47, 46.86, 107.74, 119.33, 69.47, 135.67, 62.26, 146.48, 103.59, 80.70, 116.30, 64.87, 124.88, 71.01, 107.35, 102.79, 139.41, 56.90, 101.47, 102.82, 125.76, 53.97, 84.85, 79.64] nm. Constrain each layer thickness to previous_value ± 15 nm bounds. Apply harmonic penalty toward quarter-wave optical thickness at 1150 nm center wavelength. Optimize for maximum mean transmittance in 800-1500 nm and maximum mean reflectance in 200-400 nm. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with local refinement settings. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 200-400 nm, 800-1500 nm. soft objectives: High transmission in 800-1500 nm band; High reflection in 200-400 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low transmission in 200-400 nm band; Low reflection in 800-1500 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layers <= 30; Materials limited to HfO2 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Feedback directive specifies constrained local refinement with ±15 nm step size from current best configuration to resolve coarse jumps observed in round 1.
